title: Jewel Match Deluxe
description: Journey through a whimsical world of jewels with this match 3 puzzle game. Match colorful gems to level up with classic gameplay challenges. -Create longer match combinations to earn extra points! -Unlock special jewels! -Beat your highest score!
instructions: Swap your jewels position to align them in one shiny horizontal or vertical row of three or more This clears all the matching items leaving space for more precious gems to fall into the game If you match four or more jewels they will combine to create
